title: Tortoiseshell Cats + Kittens Edit
description: Changes calico cats to tortoiseshell cats and adjusts kittens' eyes.
body:
Changes calico cats to tortoiseshell cats and adjusts kittens' eyes to appear more similar to their adult counterparts.

Here is an example image of the adult variant!
![Adult Tortoiseshell Cat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ebbf8fd5152d6316ab2eba7380911389071c98d.png)

Along with the kitten variant:
![Tortoiseshell Kitten](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ca7b311875162e2db1095ecabb6763440ebd584.png)

And finally, an example of what the new kittens' eyes look like with this pack:
![Siamese Kitten with updated eyes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01f6af82f8f68ab880d27e3bd87a1ba535f25741.png)

I hope you like them!
